title_decision: Retitled 'Singular cohomology and the cup product'. The brief's title also named Poincare duality. In every textbook in the dossier, duality for topological manifolds is its own chapter or section with its own definitions (local and R-orientations, fundamental class, cap product, cohomology with compact supports) and its own main theorem: Hatcher 3.3 is separate from 3.1-3.2; May ch. 20 from ch. 18-19; Munkres ch. 8 from ch. 5 and 7; Miller lectures 31-38 from 24-30. By rule 11 it becomes a separate new page. The existing [[poincare-duality]] page treats only the de Rham version (compact supports and integration), so it does not cover this.
